name: many-eyes-pilot5
about: Pilot 5: graded collective detection. Each fleeing first-hand detector within 80 px passes the alarm at rate lambda per second, so k detectors warn at rate lambda*k (more watchers, faster warning). Same seeds and setup as pilot 4 (alarm off / instant alarm), so the four alarm variants are directly comparable. Prediction: a negative food-adjusted vigilance slope once alarm is graded.
